description: HB Estate Developers Limited owns and manages hotels and real estate properties in India. The company operates hotels; and develops commercial complexes. It also provides allied services, including laundry, communication, health club, airport transfers, and other related services. The company was formerly known as HB Housing & Development Corporation Limited and changed its name to HB Estate Developers Limited in January 1996. HB Estate Developers Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Gurugram, India.
